create_ImagenetResizedConfig: create an ImagenetResizedConfig with a specified image size for the dataset builder
build_Builder_dataset: build an ImagenetResized Builder instance to generate resized ImageNet dataset splits
run_generate_examples: run _generate_examples to yield image and label records from npz archive files
test_split_generators: test _split_generators to download and configure train and validation data splits
review_make_builder_configs: review _make_builder_configs to generate builder configs for 8x8, 16x16, 32x32, and 64x64 sizes
